component.name: Epigraph
component.summary: Epigraph manga reader powered by Suwayomi

description.p: Epigraph is a desktop manga reader built on top of Suwayomi-Server (Tachidesk), providing a clean native interface for browsing, reading, and managing your manga library across hundreds of sources.
Svelte rewrite with improved UI, bundled server, and cross-platform fixes.
